title: Christmas beauty gift sets 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for
seoTitle: Beauty Gift Sets 2026: Buy Now or Wait for Black Friday?
description: Which Christmas 2026 beauty and fragrance gift sets are already reduced, which to wait for on Black Friday, and the prices worth paying.
intro:
**Most new Christmas 2026 beauty gift sets are still at full price, but a few are already 20–30% off, which is about what Black Friday usually brings.** The best we found today are the Carolina Herrera Good Girl set at £84 (was £105) and the Fenty Skin Lil' Mists Duo at £18.20 (was £26).

Black Friday is on 27 November. If a set you want is already 20% off, buy it now, because the popular ones sell out. If it's still at full price, wait: last year most gift sets fell by 20–30% over Black Friday weekend.

body:
## Why now?

Christmas gift sets are one of the few beauty categories where waiting can backfire. Brands make a fixed number of each set, the best-known ones (Charlotte Tilbury, Sol de Janeiro, the big designer perfumes) sell out before December, and they don't come back once they've gone. At the same time, the early Black Friday offers have already started, so some sets are now at the price you'd expect on 27 November.

As of 2 November, these beauty offers are live:

- **Boots:** its Black Friday sale started on 28 October. It also has weekly half-price Star Gifts, plus codes SAVE15 (15% off a £60 spend) and SAVE10 (10% off a £40 spend) on almost everything. See our [Boots Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/boots-black-friday-2026/).
- **John Lewis:** £20 off a £100 beauty spend with code BEAUTY100, plus gifts with purchase from Estée Lauder and Clinique.
- **Lookfantastic:** 20% off selected beauty.
- **The Perfume Shop:** up to 20% off.
- **Sephora UK:** up to 25% off skin and body care.
- **Superdrug:** early online fragrance offers now, and the full sale from 4 November to 1 December.

None of these showed end dates, so they may change before Black Friday.

## What to buy now

- **Boots Star Gifts.** These are half price or better, which beats the usual Black Friday discount on gift sets. Recent ones have included designer perfume and No7, Clinique and Elizabeth Arden skincare sets. They change each week, usually on a Friday, and don't return once they end.
- **Any set already 20% off or more**, like the Good Girl set and the Fenty duo above. Black Friday is unlikely to go much lower.
- **Sets that sell out.** If you've got your heart set on a particular Charlotte Tilbury or Sol de Janeiro set, buy it at full price rather than risk it going.

## What to wait for

- **Big-name perfume sets at full price.** The YSL Libre set is £115 now but has been as low as £86.25. Last year The Perfume Shop cut some designer fragrance by up to 50% over Black Friday, and Boots took about 25% off.
- **Bodycare and skincare sets at full price.** Rituals, Clinique and Estée Lauder sets usually join site-wide codes. Last year Lookfantastic took 30% off almost everything plus an extra 5%, Cult Beauty and Sephora took 25–30%, and Space NK 20–25%.
- **Anything you can buy in more than one shop.** Prices often differ by a few pounds between John Lewis, Boots and The Perfume Shop, so check before you pay.

## Target prices

As a rule, aim for **20–30% off the launch price** of a 2026 gift set. That's what most sets reached at Boots, Lookfantastic and Sephora last Black Friday. Anything better than 30% is a strong deal; half price only usually happens with Star Gifts or a clearance sale after Christmas.

For the sets above:

- YSL Libre 50ml set: **£90 or less** (now £115)
- Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 5 x 30ml: **£33 or less** (now £39)
- Rituals Sakura large set: **about £55**, or 20% off (now £68.90)
- Carolina Herrera Good Girl 50ml set: **£84** is already a fair price

## How to choose a beauty gift set

1. **Work out the value.** A gift set is only a bargain if you'd pay for what's inside. Check whether it has full-size products or minis. A 50ml perfume set that includes a 10ml travel spray and a body lotion is usually worth more than a single bottle.
2. **Stick to what she already uses.** A set from a brand or scent she loves is a safer bet than a 'discovery' box of things she may never use.
3. **Check the scent strength.** Eau de parfum lasts longer than eau de toilette, so compare like with like when checking prices.
4. **Look at the box.** Some sets come in a pouch or a reusable case, which makes them easier to wrap and nicer to receive.
5. **Keep the receipt.** Most big beauty retailers extend returns over Christmas, but sealed products are often only refundable if unopened.

## More gift ideas

For presents beyond beauty, our [Christmas gifts for her under £50 guide](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-her-under-50/) has nine checked ideas. For fragrance specifically, our [perfume gift sets Black Friday guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/) has more target prices, and our [beauty advent calendars guide](/guides/beauty-advent-calendars-2026/) compares this year's calendars. Everything else is on our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) page.
